name.value: Best Western Plus Mission City Lodge

description.value: A full-service Best Western Plus hotel in Mission, British Columbia, situated in the Fraser Valley and minutes from the US border crossing at Sumas, Washington — a useful stop on cross-border touring routes. The property offers an indoor pool, spa, and fitness centre alongside complimentary full hot-and-cold breakfast included with each stay. Its location on the Lougheed Highway makes it a practical overnight base for cyclists exploring the lower Fraser Valley.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
